ROKS_targets: All four distinct certified roots, unchanged checkpoints
CI_space: Spin-singlet frontier configurations through excitation rank two, plus optimized ROKS and paired CSFs. As in the existing pigment implementation, canonical closed/open CSFs overlapping retained CSFs by >=0.7 are omitted; four-open-shell recouplings are all retained.
baseline: N=2, W=5; expand N=3,4,5 at fixed W=5
coherent_sequence: W=N, N=5 through at most 16; two consecutive increments below 0.02 eV for the lowest four roots
fixed_Hamiltonian_check: Repeat last three CI windows at fixed W=16; same two-increment energy criterion
screening_check: Three random quadratic forms, dielectric solve residuals and factorized screened rows, errors below 1e-9
identity_and_optical_checks: All root intensities, native-target projector coverage >=0.49 in every direction, metric-overlap tracking and principal angles for lowest-four subspace; report optical changes separately
eigensolver_checks: Projected CI residual and metric orthonormality below 1e-8, positive projected metric, ground orthogonality and nonnegative oscillator strengths
scope: Numerical validation of fixed rank-two vertical model on source geometry. Experimental solution maxima provide context only. No blind accuracy or pigment nuclear-Hessian claim.
